library(tidyverse)
# Load data
df_params <- read_csv(
  "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/Study6.0Ratings.csv"
) |> 
  mutate(
    explanationCategory = relevel(
      factor(explanationCategory),

```{r}
df_gap <- df_params |>
  mutate(
    goodness_salience_gap = explanation_goodness - salience,
    # Strip the "_StudyN" suffix so Feet_Study3/Feet_Study4 collapse into "Feet",
    # and Stripes_Study4/Stripes_Study5 collapse into "Stripes"
    feature_type = str_remove(explanationCategory, "_Study\\d+$"),
    feature_type = relevel(factor(feature_type), ref = "Feet")
  )

model_gap_pooled <- lmer(
  goodness_salience_gap ~ feature_type + (1 | participant),
  data = df_gap
)

summary(model_gap_pooled)$coefficients
```
```{r}
raw_stripes_pooled <- summary(model_gap_pooled)$coefficients["feature_typeStripes", "Estimate"]
raw_stripes_pooled

d_stripes_pooled <- raw_stripes_pooled / sigma(model_gap_pooled)
d_stripes_pooled
```


```{r}
library(simr)
library(ggplot2)

#Note for self: Cohen's d = raw effect/noise SD

sigma_resid <- sigma(model_gap) #Residual standard deviation

# Range of hypothetical true effect sizes (Cohen's d)
target_ds <- c(0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.8, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0)
breaks    <- c(30, 50, 80, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300, 400, 500) #ns to sample

results <- list()

for (d in target_ds) { #run for each effect size
  #This line is saying we know the hypothetical D, and the residuals from the study, and we want to get raw effect
  raw <- d * sigma_resid #Multiply hypothetical effect size by multiplying it by residual SD
  
  
  m <- model_gap #Fresh version of model
  fixef(m)["featureStripes_Study4"] <- raw #Put raw effect into model
  m_ext <- extend(m, along = "participant", n = max(breaks)) #Take modified model and simulate with synthetic participants
  
  #Simulation: take each value one at a time, simulate a dataset, refit model, count if effect comes out as significant
  pc <- powerCurve(
    m_ext,
    test = fixed("featureStripes_Study4", method = "t"),
    along = "participant",
    breaks = breaks,
    nsim = 500
  )
  
  s <- summary(pc)
  s$d <- d
  results[[as.character(d)]] <- s
}

results_df <- do.call(rbind, results)

ggplot(results_df, aes(x = nlevels, y = mean, color = factor(d))) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = factor(d)), alpha = 0.1, color = NA) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  labs(x = "Number of participants", y = "Power",
       color = "Target d", fill = "Target d",
       title = "Power to detect feet vs. stripes at different assumed effect sizes") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
model_ext <- extend(model_gap, along = "participant", n = 400)

pc_observed <- powerCurve(
  model_ext,
  test = fixed("featureStripes_Study4", method = "t"),
  along = "participant",
  breaks = c(30, 50, 80, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300, 400),
  nsim = 1000
)

pc_observed_summary <- summary(pc_observed)
pc_observed_summary
ggplot(pc_observed_summary, aes(x = nlevels, y = mean)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Number of participants", y = "Power",
       title = "Power to detect the observed feet vs. stripes effect (raw ≈ 0.3, d ≈ 0.11)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
